bundle.shortDescription: A pixel-art stealth game whose guards are finite automata (DFA/NFA).
bundle.longDescription: Shadow Protocol is a Theory of Computation project: a top-down stealth game whose guards are driven by deterministic finite automata, with a live DFA visualizer, an NFA vs DFA comparison mode, an Automata Lab (editor, simulator, subset construction, JSON save/load) and an interactive tutorial.
